number.why: The served number is the reported adjusted HR for balanced solution versus saline at 90 days: 0.97 with 95% CI 0.90–1.05. Confirmation applies to the HR, not the requested RR. The ruling correctly flags that the held text does not establish the served intention-to-treat label; incomplete availability alone does not establish the precise analysis method.

quotes.span: By day 90, 1381 of 5230 patients (26.4%) assigned to a balanced solution died vs 1439 of 5290 patients (27.2%) assigned to saline solution (adjusted hazard ratio, 0.97 [95% CI, 0.90-1.05]; P = .47).
Among 11 052 patients who were randomized, 10 520 (95.2%) were available for the analysis

entry.why: The packet establishes randomized enrollment of critically ill ICU patients requiring fluid expansion, an adult minimum age, and comparison of balanced solution with 0.9% saline.

quotes.span: Double-blind, factorial, randomized clinical trial conducted at 75 ICUs in Brazil.

Patients who were admitted to the ICU with at least 1 risk factor for worse outcomes, who required at least 1 fluid expansion, and who were expected to remain in the ICU for more than 24 hours were randomized
ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 18 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL
Patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to receive either a balanced solution (n = 5522) or 0.9% saline solution (n = 5530) for all intravenous fluids.

missed: No additional finding changes either judgment. The ruling already identifies the HR-versus-RR mismatch and the unestablished intention-to-treat label; SERVED_CONFIRMED should be understood with those qualifications.
